title: Effective Bethe Ansatz for Spin-1 Non-integrable Models
summary: This work presents a comprehensive benchmark and validation of a recently proposed method called Effective Bethe Ansatz (EBA). It is a variational method that deforms the exact Bethe wavefunctions of one-dimensional spin chains at integrable points to approximate non-integrable systems. We apply this method to the non-integrable regime of the spin-1 bilinear-biquadratic chain.
